description: What a Korean family must do after a death, with dated deadlines in order: death report (1 month from learning of the death, 가족관계등록법 제84조), 안심상속 one-stop asset and debt inquiry (1 year from the end of the month of death), renunciation or limited acceptance (3 months from learning, 민법 제1019조), unpaid wages and severance (employer pays within 14 days, 근로기준법 제36조), refusing a lease succession (1 month, 주택임대차보호법 제9조), closing a business VAT return (25 days after the month end), the deceased's income tax, inheritance acquisition tax, car transfer and inheritance tax (6 months from the month end, 9 abroad), life insurance and industrial-accident survivor claims (3 years) and National Pension survivor claims (5 years). Deadlines on holidays move to the next business day. Returns each task with where to go, what to bring, the statute and what happens if missed, plus overdue and next tasks for a given today.
